newsitem.title: USA: Digital Solutions CEO in treatment program.
newsitem.headline: Digital Solutions CEO in treatment program.

text.p: Digital Solutions Inc said on Wednesday that its president and chief executive officer George Eklund is undergoing a 30-day treatment program after surgery to remove a malignant tumor.
Eklund has returned to work on a part-time basis, with chairman Karl Dieckmann assuming some of his responsibilities, the employer organization said in a statement.
The company added that Eklund intends to resume full-time activities following treatment.
